newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Gangland crime leaves three dead in Slovak capital.
newsitem.headline: Gangland crime leaves three dead in Slovak capital.

text.p: Gangland-style killings have left three people dead in the normally peaceful Slovak capital Bratislava in the last two days, police said on Friday.

The charred body of a man with his hands tied behind his back and gunshots to his legs was found near a burning limousine in a suburb on Friday and police said the killing appeared linked to organised crime.
"The car had a Zagreb, Croatia, registration number, but we still don't know the identity of the victim," interior ministry spokesman Peter Ondera told Reuters.

On Thursday, two men were killed in a shootout around midday on one of the city's busiest streets between two groups of "individuals close to the underworld" armed with shotguns and machineguns, Ondera said.

Police sources, who did not wish to be named, told the official TASR news agency that preliminary investigations indicated Thursday's killings were the result of a war between gangs dealing in illegal arms.
